name: Fiji
description: Fiji from its first voyagers to the chiefs, British rule and Indian labourers, independence in 1970, four coups and rugby.

checkpoints.name: Voyagers and chiefs
checkpoints.note: The Lapita people settled Fiji some 3,500 years ago. Chiefs fought for power, and Cakobau rose in the 1800s.

checkpoints.name: British Fiji
checkpoints.note: Fiji became a British colony in 1874, and Indian labourers came to work the sugar fields.

checkpoints.name: Independent Fiji
checkpoints.note: Fiji became independent in 1970. Coups in 1987, 2000 and 2006 followed, and its rugby players won Olympic gold.
